How is the deceleration of an object calculated from a speed–time graph?
A
It is the area under the graph.
B
It is the gradient of the graph.
C
It is the difference between two readings on the horizontal (x) axis.
D
It is the difference between two readings on the vertical (y) axis.

options.label: A
options.text: It is the area under the graph.

options.label: B
options.text: It is the gradient of the graph.

options.label: C
options.text: It is the difference between two readings on the horizontal (x) axis.

options.label: D
options.text: It is the difference between two readings on the vertical (y) axis.
